svg.title: OP-03 — QUANTUM MAZE: Escape the maze. Collapse the wavefunction.

g.text: Escape the maze. Collapse the wavefunction.
A puzzle maze where every door is a qubit. Apply H, X, Y, Z, S, T and
CNOT gates, then measure to open a path, computed by FastAPI +
Qiskit Aer with an offline TypeScript statevector fallback.
Doors are qubits; gates are your keys
Qiskit Aer backend + TS statevector fallback
